summary.text: Mu Cha Lang is a leafless old-tree Gu Immortal of Green Lotus Great World, sent from the black and white mountain when Fairy Ming Hao refuses to use Divine Emperor City herself.

claims.text: Fairy Ming Hao sends an information path Gu worm to the middle of the black and white mountain. The recipients are Gu Immortals who are neither human nor variant human. One is an old tree with a thin dry trunk, countless leafless branches of uneven length, and about a hundred thin long roots. That tree is Mu Cha Lang.

Mu Cha Lang lies on mountain rock that serves as a chair, branches wrapped around a small rock as if resting its legs on a stool. When the order arrives, it stands at once and nudges Qing Hao Zi awake, saying the sage has sent an order. The two then leave the mountain with their troops for the front lines.

Mu Cha Lang and Qing Hao Zi lead two armies through the tunnel linking Yellow Earth Great World and Green Lotus Great World. Mu Cha Lang activates Spring Upon Withered Tree: green leaves cover its whole tree body, then fly onto Green Lotus Gu Immortals, shrinking large wounds and healing small ones. It laughs that even with Yellow Earth’s sage present, Green Lotus Great World will win.

After Qing Hao Zi is hurt killing Yellow Earth Gu Immortals, it stops to receive Mu Cha Lang’s healing killer move and recovers greatly. Mu Cha Lang says healing is all it is skilled at, admires Qing Hao Zi’s kill count, and warns against dropping defense because final struggles are hard to heal. On Green Lotus’ side only Mu Cha Lang, Qing Hao Zi, and Old Forest Moss have rank eight cultivation. Facing Fang Yuan’s reinforcements, Mu Cha Lang tells its side not to fear numbers until true battle strength is shown. After the first clash it notes bitterly that Green Lotus can focus on only one aspect while the enemies all have superb healing methods.
